StormCellSpec.description:
One convective cell of the storm designer (SPEC.md 10.2; the ``/replay`` cell table).

Positions and velocities are in :attr:`StormDesign.crs`, the city's metric CRS.
``birth_min`` is minutes from the bundle's ``t0`` and may be negative, which means the
cell was already alive when the replay window opened.

birth_min.description: Minutes from t0 at which the cell is born.
birth_min.title: Birth Min

lifetime_min.description: Minutes from birth to death; the sine envelope spans exactly this.
lifetime_min.title: Lifetime Min

peak_mm_h.description: Peak rain rate at the cell centre before intensity_scale is applied.
peak_mm_h.title: Peak Mm H

sigma_m.description: Gaussian radius in metres (2-6 km in the demo storm).
sigma_m.title: Sigma M

start_x_m.description: Cell centre at birth, easting in the design CRS.
start_x_m.title: Start X M

start_y_m.description: Cell centre at birth, northing in the design CRS.
start_y_m.title: Start Y M

StormCellSpec.title: StormCellSpec

description:
Storm-designer parameters for a reconstructed replay (SPEC.md 10.2, 7.8).

Everything needed to regenerate ``truth/rain.zarr`` and ``radar/frames.zarr`` byte for
byte: the cells, the stratiform background, the wind, the calibration multiplier and the
radar-rendering constants. The ``/replay`` storm designer renders :attr:`cells` as a table.

background_mm_h.description: Stratiform background rain rate (2-5 mm/h in the demo storm).
background_mm_h.title: Background Mm H

coverage_radius_km.description: Radar coverage circle; pixels outside it carry no echo.
coverage_radius_km.title: Coverage Radius Km

crs.description: EPSG code of the metric CRS the cell coordinates use.
crs.title: Crs

dbz_class_width.description: Reflectivity class width in dBZ (decoded imagery is 5 dBZ).
dbz_class_width.title: Dbz Class Width

intensity_scale.description: Multiplier calibrate() applied to every cell peak.
intensity_scale.title: Intensity Scale

min_dbz.description: Frames below this class read as no echo, as a decoded image does.
min_dbz.title: Min Dbz

notes.description: Designer choices this bundle must state out loud.
notes.title: Notes

seed.description: Seed of the generator (2019 for the demo bundle).
seed.title: Seed

speckle_sigma.description: Standard deviation of the multiplicative log-normal speckle applied to Z.
speckle_sigma.title: Speckle Sigma

wind_from_deg.description: Meteorological direction the cells come from (225 = south-west).
wind_from_deg.title: Wind From Deg

title: StormDesign
